label: 宵闇の花冠
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Transparent FOUR-frame battle VFX sheet EXACT 2x2 equal cells, order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. one huge dark crimson-violet lotus eruption, sharp petals open from low circle with white-magenta core and sparse gold flecks. Frame1 onset at 25% intensity, frame2 energetic expansion, frame3 spectacular maximum impact, frame4 dying fragments. Refined fantasy JRPG pixel art, chunky crisp clusters and stepped edges, dark defined contour, high contrast, dramatic late-game power. No character, weapon prop, landscape, solid floor, text, labels, grid, checkerboard, watermark, photographic smoke or airbrush. Actual transparent alpha including hollow centers. Each full effect in its own cell with 12% clear padding; no clipping or overlap. Local 0..1024 coordinates: fixed ground center (512,850), expand upward/outward; elliptical side-view base. Keep size consistent, only purposeful expansion varies. Palette black/violet/crimson with silver/gold accents.
reviewStatus: all source frames visually reviewed; playback and runtime acceptance pending

observations: 黒赤紫の花弁が開き、白い核と金の粒子で派手な闇花を表現。
issues: 発生コマから花が大きく開いている。花弁の開く順序を整理する。
最大コマの上向きの噴出が高い。花と魔柱の形の差を維持する。
